activity.notes: On 1 September 1928 Albania was proclaimed a monarchy and Ahmet Zogu became Zog I, King of the Albanians. His effective rule in Albania ended with the Italian invasion on 7 April 1939, when he left the country. ATLAS therefore records the Kingdom of Albania as the relevant polity and uses 1 September 1928 through 7 April 1939 as the representative effective royal reign, without extending the Activity through later exile claims.

sources.title: History of the Assembly of Albania
sources.citation_text: The Parliament of Albania records the proclamation of the monarchy and Ahmet Zog as King of the Albanians on 1 September 1928, followed by the Italian invasion on 7 April 1939 and Zog's departure from Albania.

sources.title: History of the Institution of the President
sources.citation_text: The Presidency of Albania records the transition from republic to monarchy on 1 September 1928 and identifies Ahmet Zogu as Zog I, King of the Albanians, until the 1939 Italian invasion.

sources.title: Recognition of the Kingdom of Albania and King Zog I
sources.citation_text: The U.S. Department of State historical record documents the international recognition of the Albanian monarchy and King Zog I in 1928.
